meta.purpose: Regression baseline for SameChannelPolicy merge decisions. Prevents threshold tuning from fixing one over-merge while silently breaking known-good merges.

classification.must_merge: Pairwise cases that must pass. Clean, high-confidence same-story progressions with strong kw+conv+anchor evidence. If these fail, the policy is too strict.
classification.must_not_merge: Pairwise cases that must not merge. Broad set of negative examples that reveal policy flaws. If these pass, the policy is too permissive.
classification.scenario_e2e: Cases where direct pairwise merge is ambiguous or incorrect. Requires full state accumulation via EventConsolidator. Tests event narrative grouping over time, not single-step match.

meta.pairwise_note: Pairwise tests use a seed-only event from candidate_a, then score candidate_b. No state accumulation — conservative for must_merge, appropriate for must_not_merge. Stateful failures (where accumulated conversation_ids cause the problem) will only appear in end-to-end tests. apple_wwdc_to_gemini is deliberately excluded from pairwise: forcing it to pass pairwise would require loosening weights that would then cause apple/nvidia-style over-merging.
meta.acceptance: must_merge all pass, must_not_merge all pass, scenario_e2e groupings correct. Fragmentation (everything → isolated) is not acceptable.

pairwise.notes: Same story, same science channel. Two consecutive 35-min windows of the same diabetes/journals story. Should merge on top_conv_match + strong kw/domain overlap.
Microsoft open-source tools hacked / password theft. Two tech-channel candidates 35 min apart. High kw (github/security/access) and domain (techcrunch/github/macrumors) overlap.
Switzerland population referendum. Two general-channel candidates with consistent switzerland/population/swiss/admin.ch keywords and domains. Both from the clean 2-candidate event.

SBF pardon (pardons/pardon/trump) vs Brexit referendum flip. Different stories. Shared Bloomberg/TechCrunch domains and startup channel, but kw=0. Currently failing: startup channel has no kw=0 block so conv=1.0 + dom=1.0 carries the merge.

DaVinci Resolve / Gemma 4 12B window (features/quantum/models/google keywords) vs Elixir v1.20 gradual typing release. Different technical topics. Candidate_a id is inferred from audit (verify if SKIP).

Elixir v1.20 gradual typing release vs abortion/miscarriage story (faced/threatening/miscarriage/abortion keywords). Completely different topics. General channel kw=0 block should reject this. (candidate_a is cluster 0 — the true Elixir discussion; cluster 2 is a noise cluster with spam keywords)

xAI datacenter REIT story (where/social/into/back/data) vs Switzerland population referendum (population/switzerland/swiss). Generic keyword overlap on where/social/into is not event identity. Pairwise currently fails (score=0.299); the stateful version is even worse in e2e.

Switzerland population cap referendum vs farmer donated land / city building data center. Different civic stories. From same window (same parquet file, different cluster). Domain or conversation overlap should not be enough.

Apple WWDC Livestream (apple/siri/live/zig/macos) vs Nvidia partners with LG robotics to build humanoid robots. Same tech window and shared domains (apple.com/github.com), but completely different event. Tests that domain overlap alone does not carry a tech-channel merge.

Cloudflare Turnstile WebGL fingerprinting vs a non-Cloudflare general candidate from the adjacent window. Tests that a strong Cloudflare event does not absorb unrelated general candidates due to window proximity. Candidate_b id is approximate (cluster 1 in next window); verify if SKIP.
Google Chrome Manifest V3 / ad-blocker story. Two consecutive tech-channel windows (Jun 16). score=0.465, top_match=True, kw=0.25 (chrome/blockers/google/browser), conv=0.46, dom=0.80.
Feds/Fable 5 Xbox AI security story. Two consecutive security-channel windows (Jun 16). score=0.536, top_match=True, kw=0.375 (security/vulnerability/bug/fix), conv=0.60, dom=1.0.
AI adoption skepticism story ('No, everyone is not using AI'). Two consecutive ai-channel windows (Jun 14). score=0.611, top_match=True, kw=0.571 (llm/models/llms/agent/code), conv=0.75, dom=1.0.

Chrome ad-blockers story vs Apple anti-nausea dots story. Same tech channel on Jun 16 but completely different topics. kw=0 (origin/ublock/brave/chrome vs feature/tools/git/records). Score=0. Regression guard for Step 3.

SpaceX/Cursor $60B acquisition (Jun 16) vs AI adoption skepticism story (Jun 14). Same ai channel but 2 days apart and different topics. score=0.029, kw=0.125 (models/llms overlap is incidental). Time gap > 90 min; tests that ai channel does not over-merge topic-adjacent but story-distinct events.

expected_same_event.notes: Both diabetes candidates must land in the same TrackedEvent. A single coherent 2-candidate science event.
Both Microsoft-hacked candidates must land in the same TrackedEvent.
The clean 2-candidate Switzerland referendum event must remain merged.

Apple WWDC livestream → Apple Gemini AI architecture announcement. Different story IDs so direct pairwise merge is too weak (score=0.125). With evolved event, score=0.220 — just below 0.25. Anchor 48448106 (WWDC livestream) appears in Gemini cluster's conv_ids — reverse anchor match would fix. Requires Step 3 policy extension.
All 5 Chrome Manifest V3 / ad-blocker candidates (Jun 16) must land in the same TrackedEvent.
All 3 Fable 5 / Xbox AI security candidates (Jun 16) must land in the same TrackedEvent.
All 7 'No, everyone is not using AI' candidates (Jun 14) must land in the same TrackedEvent.
